title: Welcome
headline: Discover your bodygraph, calculated with precision.
lead: Enter your birth date, time and place: in seconds you get type, strategy, authority, profile and all 26 activations, using Swiss Ephemeris and historical time zones.

precise.title: Astronomical precision
precise.text: The same engine as the reference software, verified against hundreds of births.

private.title: Private by design
private.text: Calculations and data stay on your device. No account, no tracking.

bilingual.title: Italian and English
bilingual.text: Original texts on two levels: simple to get started, in-depth to study.

footnote: Human Design is a tool for reflection, not a science and not professional advice.
